run.scope: The whole site: login, session, catalog, cart, checkout, menu and the six test users. Read from the live site only, no source code.
run.summary: A practice online shop by Sauce Labs. Users log in with one of six test accounts, browse 6 products, add them to a cart and check out. There is no real payment.

inputs.ref: Credentials listed on the login page (accepted usernames and password)

risks: Checkout totals and tax are money
Login and session gate every page
The cart decides what is bought
Some test users are built to misbehave, so every user type needs the main journey
run.existing_tests: None visible: site only, no repository. Scans in inventory/ and inventory-logged-in/; observed behaviour in inventory/observations.json and inventory/observations-2.txt.

tools.reporting: Built-in HTML + JUnit XML (+ GitHub annotations in CI); Allure not chosen

approval.notes: The owner asked to prove the skill with the recommended options. Approved for the starter: the 11 P1 cases plus TC-USERS-001 and TC-USERS-002, to show how a failing test is reported. The other 41 cases stay suggested.

rules.text: Username is required: 'Epic sadface: Username is required'
Password is required: 'Epic sadface: Password is required'
Accepted usernames: standard_user, locked_out_user, problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, visual_user; password secret_sauce for all
Wrong or unknown credentials: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service'
locked_out_user is refused: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

features.name: Session and access control
features.risk_reason: Private pages must not open without a login

rules.text: A logged-out visit to a private page returns to / with 'Epic sadface: You can only access '<path>' when you are logged in.'
rules.source: observations.json: deepLinkLoggedOut; observations-2.txt: step2 logged out

rules.text: Logout from the menu returns to the login page

features.name: Product catalog and sorting
features.risk_reason: Wrong prices or order mislead the buyer, but checkout shows the totals again

rules.text: 6 products with prices: Backpack $29.99, Bike Light $9.99, Bolt T-Shirt $15.99, Fleece Jacket $49.99, Onesie $7.99, Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) $15.99
Sort options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), Price (high to low). Default A to Z

features.name: Cart
features.risk_reason: The cart decides what is bought and charged

rules.text: Add to cart turns the button into Remove and updates the badge count
The badge disappears when the cart is empty
The cart survives a reload and a logout/login
rules.source: observations-2.txt: badge after reload 1, badge after logout+login 1

features.name: Checkout
features.risk_reason: Money: totals, tax and the order itself

rules.text: First Name, Last Name and Postal Code are required, checked in that order: 'Error: First Name is required', 'Error: Last Name is required', 'Error: Postal Code is required'
Tax looks like 8% of the item total, rounded to the cent: $39.98 -> $3.20; $129.94 -> $10.40; $7.99 -> $0.64
rules.source: observations.json: twoItems, allItemsTotals; observations-2.txt: onesie (inferred, not documented)

rules.text: Finish shows 'Thank you for your order!' and empties the cart
Cancel on step one returns to the cart; Cancel on step two returns to the product list with the cart kept
rules.source: observations-2.txt: cancel step1 url, cancel step2 url

rules.text: No length or format limits on the three fields in HTML

features.name: Side menu
features.risk_reason: Navigation helpers; Reset App State touches the cart

rules.text: Menu items: All Items, Dynamic Catalog, About, Logout, Reset App State
About links to https://saucelabs.com/

features.gaps: No negative input on the menu. Dynamic Catalog (Lazy Load, Spinner, Slider) was found but not explored: see Not covered.

features.name: User types
features.risk_reason: Four accepted users are built to show bugs, slowness or visual changes; each is a separate equivalence class

rules.text: Every accepted user except locked_out_user can log in and should be able to buy

features.gaps: Each user type is one partition of valid input, so all cases here are happy-path checks run with a different user. Negative cases per user are covered by F-LOGIN.

features.name: Browsers, devices and accessibility
features.risk_reason: The same journey must work for every buyer
features.gaps: Checklist items, no input of their own.

questions.question: Should checkout be possible with an empty cart? Today a $0.00 order completes, and the item total shows '$0' instead of '$0.00'.
questions.why: Creates empty orders; the price format is inconsistent

questions.question: Should names and postal codes made only of spaces be refused?
questions.why: Orders with blank names cannot be delivered

questions.question: After Reset App State, the cart is emptied but the product buttons keep saying 'Remove' until a reload. Is that intended?
questions.why: The screen disagrees with the cart; a click on 'Remove' then does nothing useful

questions.question: Is tax 8% of the item total, rounded half up to the cent? Where is the rule written?
questions.why: Money expectations need a written rule, not an inference

questions.question: What are the maximum lengths and allowed characters for First Name, Last Name and Postal Code?
Should spaces around the username be trimmed?
Should the order confirmation page open when no order was placed?
questions.why: Shows 'Thank you for your order!' without an order

questions.question: The login page logs two 401 errors and the product list one 404. Are these expected?
questions.why: Console noise hides real errors in automated checks

questions.question: What is the time budget for reaching the product list after login?
questions.why: performance_glitch_user takes about 5 seconds; a test needs a number

questions.question: Should the sort choice be kept after viewing a product? How are ties on price ordered?
questions.source: observations-2.txt: sort after back, lohi order
questions.why: Today the sort resets to A to Z; tie order is undocumented

questions.question: Should the cart be kept after logout?
questions.why: On a shared computer the next user sees the cart

questions.question: A product URL with an unknown ID (id=99) shows 'ITEM NOT FOUND' with price '$√-1' and a working Add to cart. The cart badge then shows 1 while the cart list is empty. Intended?
questions.why: A non-existent item can be put in the cart; badge and cart disagree. Checkout with it was not checked
